title: The Best Group Chat
author: Ines Quintana
blurb: Odile Lockridge, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
